---
title: "Crosswalk to the complete Rails section"
---

The following pages are the complete source components summarized in this
report. They remain the authoritative location for interactive figures,
exploratory analyses, and implementation details.

| Component | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [Dashboard](../../content/rails-dashboard.html) | Deployment, recording, and rail-detection overview |
| [Introduction](../../content/rails-intro.html) | Scope and motivation for the pilot |
| [Methods](../../content/rails-methods.html) | Study area, recorders, detection, distance, and index methods |
| [Summary](../../content/rails-summary.html) | Temporal and diurnal results |
| [Population assessment](../../content/rails-assessment.html) | Detection range, density, ASCR, and habitat questions |
| [Assessment details](../../content/rails-assessment-details.html) | Supporting assessment notes and exploratory analysis |
| [Biodiversity](../../content/rails-biodiversity.html) | Community and acoustic-index analyses |
| [Bats](../../content/rails-bats.html) | High-frequency monitoring component |
| [Insects](../../content/rails-insects.html) | Insect monitoring component |
| [Future research](../../content/rails-future.html) | Survey-design and management recommendations |
| [Sound exploration](../../content/exploreSounds.html) | Examples of recorded sounds and review context |
| [Rails sound examples](../../content/_rails-sounds.qmd) | Shared sound-analysis material used by the Rails pages |

The source files for these pages are in [`content/`](../../content/). Data and
analysis scripts are retained in [`data/`](../../data/) and [`_code/`](../../_code/)
so that future studies can reproduce or extend the workflow.
